name_note: Most published work on this genus concerns Eggerthella lenta, the species that dominates the NCBI names of genomes GTDB places in g__Eggerthella.

sentences.text: Eggerthella lenta is an asaccharolytic obligate anaerobe of the human gut that grows on amino acids and short-chain fatty acids.
A review describes its versatile anaerobic respiration and extensive biotransformation of endogenous, diet-derived and pharmaceutical small molecules.
One study reported that Eggerthella lenta strains convert procyanidins, oligomers of flavan-3-ols, by opening the C-ring of the terminal unit.
The same review reports that it is associated with a wide range of chronic diseases in humans and exacerbates disease in preclinical models.
